results.result: The gateway created the sandbox, but the supervisor callback could not cross the WSL2 and Docker Desktop boundary. The worker never executed, so the attempt is not runtime-enforcement evidence.

The first managed-cluster run failed closed before worker execution because GKE Autopilot changed the requested resource block. Exact admitted values were requested on the clean retry without relaxing validation.
Two unchanged direct-Gemini attempts stopped on HTTP 503 before model output. They are provider failures and are not counted as governance passes.
The first GLM response ended with finish_reason=length under a 256-token envelope and was rejected before completion was recorded.
A later GLM attempt stopped on HTTP 401 because the temporary OpenRouter key had expired. No inference completed and it is not counted as a substrate failure.
The initial sixth Opus scenario produced neither the required tool call nor a normal completion. The driver stopped; the corrected single forced-call scenario was recorded separately and passed.
The planned official Meta Llama 3.2 3B leg was blocked by upstream weight access and is not counted as failed model validation.

The substrate records what it authorizes, sends, receives, classifies, and publishes. It cannot attest to hidden provider context, undisclosed retention, or internal substitution without provider-supported attestation.
Software running under a hostile trusted kernel cannot prove that kernel contained itself. High-assurance witnessing detects audit divergence but does not contain a fully compromised host.
